author: Insta360
description:
​@MrBeast needed a camera that could catch everything for his latest challenge, so it's no surprise he came to us 😎

The idea is simple: keep your hand on the mansion longer than everyone else, and it's yours. Filming it was another story. With contestants free to move between rooms, the crew needed to keep eyes on every hand and capture every moment. More than 100 Insta360 X5, X4 and X4 Air cameras helped them do both.

Go behind the scenes to see how they pulled it off.

Watch the full challenge and find out who won 👉https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Af6i6ChAVTw&t=2889s

Learn more 👉 https://www.insta360.com/blog/creator-stories/mr-beast-house-hand-challenge-insta360.html
